sloka: न मत् कृते विनश्येयुः सर्वे ते नर वानराः ।अशोक वनिका च अपि महती इयम् महा द्रुमा ॥५-१३-५५॥
transliteration: na mat kṛte vinaśyeyuḥ sarve te nara vānarāḥ ।aśoka vanikā ca api mahatī iyam mahā drumā ॥5-13-55॥

translations.english: "Here is the Ashoka grove with huge trees. I will go there. I have not looked for her in this place.
